privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body:
Monete uses no cookies, no tracking and no ads.

What we store: only what the host asks for in the party (children's names, and if enabled, date of birth and allergies, plus the number of adults). No accounts, no email, no payments.

Where: data is stored encrypted on Supabase servers in Europe.

How long: each party is automatically deleted 90 days after its date.

Deletion: the host can delete the party and all its data at any time with “Delete party”. You can also write to endika2@gmail.com.

Contact: endika2@gmail.com.
